snippet.title: PHAZIKA | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4354930/PHAZIKA/

Click to freeze time. Release to redirect your momentum. That's all you need. Bend time and wrangle physics as you survive and speedrun through abstract psychedelic worlds at hyperspeed pace, dodging bullets and zigzagging through impossible obstacles.
